findings.desc: experience-hint-loader.ts:62 ExperienceHint.priority JSDoc claims "signalScore * log(1+support) * recencyBoost" but for common_false_positive hints the actual computation is falsePositiveCount * log(1+support) * recencyBoost (line 195: computePriority(fpStrength, signal.support, boost)). The exported interface JSDoc misrepresents the priority formula for one of its two hint kinds. Fix: update the jsdoc to say "For recurring: signalScore * log(1+support) * recencyBoost. For common_false_positive: falsePositiveCount * log(1+support) * recencyBoost."
findings.resolvedReason: Updated ExperienceHint.priority JSDoc to describe both kinds: base=signalScore (recurring) / falsePositiveCount (common_false_positive). Commit 07d048a9.

findings.desc: CHK-003:edge:0 verificationIntent claims "Surface hints twice for the same story in the same review run -> exactly one experience_hint_surfaced event (deduplicated), not two" but neither the code nor the smoke implements or tests this. The code fires one appendActivityLog per story_review() invocation unconditionally when hasExperienceHints is true (story-review.ts:545-553), so two calls to story_review() on the same story produce TWO events. The smoke (21 tests) never calls runStoryReview twice on the same storyId. The verificationEvidence for CHK-003:edge:0 cites npm run test:experience-layer-hint-injection which passes 21/21 but provides zero coverage of the cross-call dedup claim. Fix: either (a) add a dedup guard in story-review.ts that checks whether an event was already appended for this story in this review round, or (b) redefine the intent to mean "within one story_review() call, exactly one event" (which IS already true and tested), and add a smoke test for two consecutive calls to prove the current behavior clearly.
findings.resolvedReason: Implemented exactly-once-per-review-round dedup in story-review.ts (key=story.currentReviewRound, fallback plan:phase; reads back activity log, skips duplicate). Added smoke check 'CHK-003:edge:0 surface twice same run => one event'. Smoke 22/22. Commit 07d048a9.
